title: Asking the way
subtitle: Direcciones
review: Written by Claude in Latin American (Mexican) Spanish. Check the Spanish, the English and the notes before recording audio. English support only.

categories.desc: Finding a place, and finding out how far it is.
cards: Excuse me, where is the bathroom?
Hay: there is, there are. Cerca: near.
Disculpe, ¿hay una farmacia cerca de aquí?
Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
Llegar a: to get to. El centro: the middle of town.
Excuse me, how do I get downtown?
— ¿Está lejos? — No, está a dos cuadras.
— Is it far? — No, it's two blocks away.

categories.desc: Straight on, left, right, and counting in blocks.
cards: Careful: derecho is straight, derecha is right.
Siga todo derecho hasta el semáforo.
Keep straight on to the traffic light.
To the right. / On the right.
Dé vuelta a la derecha en la esquina.
To the left. / On the left.
El banco está a la izquierda.
The bank is on the left.
Una cuadra: a city block. Distances in town are counted in blocks.
El mercado está a dos cuadras de aquí.
The market is two blocks from here.
La parada está en la esquina.
The bus stop is on the corner.
In Mexico a city bus is un camión. Elsewhere: un autobús.
Excuse me, which bus goes downtown?
Bajarse: to get off. Subirse: to get on.
Where do I get off for the museum?
Disculpe, me bajo aquí, por favor.
Excuse me, I'm getting off here, please.
El boleto: the ticket, in Mexico.
How much is the ticket to Puebla?
